decisions.summary: Selected eligible partner receives the offer. Accept: UAE pays exactly2% of offer-date GDP, gains15 Army experience and −5% training time for730 days. Partner grants access to instructors without an imposed treasury debit. Reject: no charge or benefit. Cooldown730 days; replacement, no stacking.

decisions.label: Offer a Technical Exchange
decisions.summary: Selected eligible partner receives the offer. Accept: UAE pays exactly2% of offer-date GDP, gains10 productivity points per controlled state once; partner chooses whether to provide experts and has no automatic payment. Reject: nothing charged or granted. Cooldown730 days per partner.

decisions.label: Request British Co-Financing
decisions.summary: Offer one agreed development grant. UK acceptance: UK treasury −$0.25bn, UAE treasury +$0.25bn, once per country programme. UK must have the money and UAE must still be its subject under the compact. Refusal/expiry moves no money; paid flag prevents repeat grants even after government changes.

decisions.label: Amend the Withdrawal Terms
decisions.summary: Available for the starting withdrawal schedule or an accepted replacement compact: propose a different date or change the protection/cooperation terms. Both countries must explicitly accept the same amendment. The current schedule remains in force until a valid replacement is accepted before its deadline; UK cannot silently postpone it. Replace both mirrored spirits and nonce together. Normal historical withdrawal requires no use of this decision.

decisions.label: The British Withdrawal Policy
decisions.summary: The withdrawal schedule and paired spirits already exist on 1 January 1970. No UK approval decision is needed for the normal historical release. UK may offer earlier release, handover cooperation or renewed protection; changing the baseline requires UAE consent. A pending or refused offer never pauses the scheduled release.

starting_spirits.label: British Withdrawal Announced
starting_spirits.description: In January 1968 Britain announced that its forces would leave the Gulf by the end of 1971. The Trucial rulers must prepare for the end of British protection. Until that withdrawal, Britain retains its external-affairs and defence responsibilities.

native_consequences.Starting withdrawal schedule: Present from 1 January 1970 in both countries. Announced deadline: by the end of 1971. Historical scenario execution: 1 December 1971, without a new petition, focus or UK vote.
native_consequences.Existing British subject relation: Native subject restrictions remain until actual release; no duplicate factory-transfer penalty.
native_consequences.Changing the plan: An earlier release or continued protection needs mutual consent. Unsigned or refused talks leave the original schedule running.

starting_spirits.treatment: Reuse the existing treaty_dependence ID and −10% political power contribution. Replace its visible terms after an accepted compact; deactivate on actual release. Sovereign federal formation remains a separate focus.

starting_spirits.label: Fragmented Authority
starting_spirits.description: Separate courts, administrations and forces make common action expensive and difficult.
starting_spirits.treatment: Constitutional bargains reduce administration costs; Union Command or Coordinated Commands treats the military penalty. No permanent extra penalty after full removal.

starting_spirits.label: Unequal Development
starting_spirits.description: Abu Dhabi has oil; Dubai has commerce; the northern emirates have much less fiscal room.
starting_spirits.treatment: Charter bargain, accession, solidarity and crisis mediation remove explicit parts. These are national reforms and survive a change of government.

starting_spirits.label: Scarce Specialists
starting_spirits.description: Oil revenue cannot instantly supply teachers, technicians, doctors or administrators.
starting_spirits.treatment: Training or specialist recruitment provides an initial remedy; Technical Institutes completes the structural remedy.

starting_spirits.label: Water and Power Constraints
starting_spirits.description: Coastal expansion depends on costly water distribution, desalination and reliable generation.
starting_spirits.treatment: Water for the Towns removes the productivity penalty and reduces the energy penalty to +5%; its own +6% operating contribution is still explicit.

starting_spirits.label: A Narrow Revenue Base
starting_spirits.description: The emirates possess valuable reserves, but only a small operating oil industry. Producing wells and offshore systems need costly investment; the broader productive and service economy remains thin.

native_consequences.Starting base oil: 4 total: Abu Dhabi3 + Dubai1 instead of inherited47, a proposed91.49% reduction in mapped operating capacity.
native_consequences.Oil development: Four once-paid focuses add8 /10 /15 /10 base oil for0.75 /2.50 /5.00 /8.00 billion. Nominal capacity after all four is47 before extraction modifiers or depletion.
native_consequences.Oil receipts: Native prices and actual exports determine receipts; no duplicate percentage income debuff is added.

starting_spirits.treatment: Paid expansion supplies operating oil. Oil downturn preparation and Earnings beyond Oil remove the two civilian penalty steps. Commercial Courts and Earnings beyond Oil remove the office penalty steps.

starting_spirits.label: An Expatriate Workforce
starting_spirits.description: Imported workers expand the labour force without giving the rulers an equivalent citizen military reserve.
starting_spirits.treatment: A structural trade-off. Residency and education do not silently convert migrants into recruitable citizens; no mass citizenship decision is assumed.

programme_rules.approval: CONCEPT ONLY. No loaded focus, history, character, idea, decision, on-action, GFX or localisation file is changed. All new proposed IDs begin COLDWAR_UAE_.
programme_rules.politics: Use the existing outlook and exact subparty system. Available checks gate meaningful programmes immediately when their governing party is in office. Fixed branches remain visible and locked, following MD Russia; no redundant outlook unlock focus.
programme_rules.lifecycle: Persist earned progress separately from active government programmes. Recalculate enabled dynamic modifiers after government change, succession, load and a periodic fallback. When the qualifying party returns, restore only earned ongoing contributions; never rerun buildings, productivity grants, cash or diplomacy.
programme_rules.exact_parties: The two internal paths in the Arab and Left clusters have exact-party conditions as well as their shared cluster gate. Moving between those parties suspends their branch-specific programme while common earned institutional gains remain. The presidency is not assumed from the ruling-party slot alone.
programme_rules.stacking: Numbers in focus details are contributions, not whole-spirit replacements. One earned contribution per focus, counted once. Political positive stability contributions have a combined +15 percentage-point cap per currently active programme, all negatives remain. Economic and military contributions otherwise add as shown; mutually exclusive alternatives never stack.
programme_rules.national_reforms: Starting-spirit remedies are permanent and order independent. Recompute each component from its immutable original value plus once-earned remedy credits, strongest credit within a shared stage family, then clamp at zero. A target stage is converted to its relief against the original component, never written onto the current value. Charter and Zayed construction relief combine; army integration stages use the strongest relief, not a sum. Never replay one-time rewards or turn deletion of a penalty into an extra positive modifier. Accepted crisis settlements add their own once-earned credits; rejection adds none.
programme_rules.conditional_deals: State Participation +15% oil export revenue activates only after its contract is accepted. Nine-state +1 investment capacity activates only with an accepted broad federation settlement. The focus unlocks an offer, not acceptance. Training Agreements and Across the Blocs grant only their contract decisions, never the listed contract rewards immediately.
programme_rules.money: Cash values are MD billions. Costed focuses require funds at completion. Decisions freeze their GDP-based price at offer/start, show the concrete numeric debit, recheck acceptance and feasibility, and execute atomically once. No implicit debt or free money on rejection.
programme_rules.projects: All promised factories, offices and fossil plants are QUEUED with ordinary native construction, staffing and energy requirements; the small cash fee funds preparation only. State179=Dubai, state180=Abu Dhabi. Port levels require verified coastal provinces and capacity; no level11 Abu Dhabi port.
programme_rules.diplomacy: Foreign players retain consent over treaties, equity contracts, GCC membership, bases, federation integration and transfers. Individual northern emirates are a political ledger inside the existing two UAE states. Bahrain/Qatar integration and non-state islands need explicit negotiated representation, not guessed map changes.
programme_rules.time: Most focuses take21/35 days; major settlements49 days, matching Russia. Real event context remains: withdrawal1971, Islah1974, military union1976, GCC1981, oil slump1986. Earlier institutional models are labelled alternatives; no blanket year locks or forced historical wars. A Kuwait-invasion response is available from early Gulf Diplomacy whenever the invasion exists, independent of the later Gulf Crisis focus or the islands choices.
programme_rules.calibration: Balance is proposed, not engine tested. StartGDP target0.686bn;1%=0.00686bn. Check actual new-game output before implementing. The starting OOB and equipment work remains deferred. No F-16 Block60 Cold War grant.
programme_rules.oil_programme: Start with4 raw oil units: AbuDhabi3/Dubai1 instead of47. First development costs0.75bn for+8; onshore2.50bn for+10; offshore5.00bn for+15; second offshore8.00bn for+10. Total16.25bn for+43 base oil. Each phase requires actual funding, ownership/control and an unpaid project flag. The main onshore and offshore expansions are compatible and follow either ownership/services settlement.
programme_rules.oil_economy: Apply reduced raw resources BEFORE the existing1970 GDP snapshot calibration, then freeze the native accounting offset once. This preserves the authored0.686bn initialGDP target without restoring oil units or oil export cash. Later oil phases grow endogenousGDP. Native demand, extraction, world prices and six-month depletion continue; nominal47 after all grants is not an output guarantee or periodic refill.
programme_rules.british_flow: Start BOTH countries with British Withdrawal Announced spirits and the pre-existing schedule. The historical release executes on 1 December 1971 without a focus or new UK approval. The 1968 announced deadline was the end of 1971; the precise date is a labelled historical scenario convention. Initial focus choice: seek a mutually accepted protection extension or prepare the already-planned handover and negotiate optional earlier release/terms. Only accepted replacements change the baseline. Sovereign British Withdrawal still requires actual is_subject = no plus founder consent.
programme_rules.british_lifecycle: Protection programmes need British subject status and an accepted compact, and suspend on release or a new overlord. Friendship requires a separate accepted independent-state treaty. A refusal permits a180-day retry or a new protection proposal; initial focus exclusions remain intact. Preserve the Council/interim administration until real formation rather than letting a character-expiry date create a federal president.
programme_rules.british_maturity: A once-only new-1970 bootstrap creates the starting schedule and mirrored spirits. Daily/load observers and a scheduled callback execute the CURRENT starting-policy schedule or mutually accepted replacement once when due, without a new UK veto or focus gate. Pending/refused offers do not pause it. Keep origin, nonce and date in both countries; never restore the baseline over an accepted renewal on load. Timed-spirit expiry alone does not free UAE. No automatic payment, army, faction or war is bundled into release.

starting_resources.label: Limited Operating Oil Capacity
starting_resources.source_contract: Validate the audited raw Dubai7 / AbuDhabi40 snapshot before applying the one-off reductions. No monthly resource reset.
starting_resources.setup_order: New1970 campaign only: apply low-oil deltas BEFORE the existing1970 GDP calibration freezes its accounting offset. Retain the authored0.686bn GDP snapshot, fewer actual export units and less oil export cash. Never recalibrate after investment.
starting_resources.scope: Base units represent operating capacity, not geological reserves or a historical barrels/day estimate. Technology, infrastructure, native prices and depletion remain active.

british_treaties.record_contract: Both countries START on 1 January 1970 with British Withdrawal Announced spirits and the same existing withdrawal schedule. Its origin is the British policy announced in 1968, not a newly signed independence request. Mirror one current schedule/compact ID, origin, nonce, terms and dates. Later bilateral agreements replace that record only on mutual acceptance; an unsigned offer creates no new signed-agreement spirit.
british_treaties.timer_contract: Store a relative due date with the verified native global.date convention and GetDateStringNoHourLong display. A360-day term uses the native investment pattern: copy global.date, add8.64. Historical1December1971 uses a literal date trigger and an explicit English date, avoiding an invented numeric date conversion. Timed-idea expiry alone never frees the country.
british_treaties.delivery_contract: The normal historical withdrawal is scheduled from the 1970 start and needs NO focus, UAE petition or new UK acceptance. Use 1 December 1971 as the explicitly labelled historical scenario execution date; the 1968 announcement specified the end of 1971, not that precise signed date. A daily/load observer and scheduled wake-up execute the current starting schedule or accepted replacement once. Recheck both countries, origin/nonce/date and actual British subject status. An unanswered or refused offer never pauses the baseline. If already free, close without replay; another overlord or annexation invalidates stale British delivery.
british_treaties.changes_contract: An EARLIER release, negotiated handover terms or continued protection needs both countries’ agreement. A mutually accepted renewed compact can replace the starting withdrawal schedule only BEFORE its due date. Recheck the current nonce, both countries, actual British subject status and the unfulfilled schedule at acceptance; a late popup cannot postpone a deadline that is already due. Process the due release first. A pending, refused or expired renewal changes nothing. Handover-only cooperation preserves the existing date unless an explicit date amendment is accepted. UK cannot unilaterally postpone the baseline; government changes and focus completion do not reset it. Refusals permit renewed talks after180 days; only one current offer at a time.
british_treaties.continuity_contract: While still protected, and while independent but not yet federated, retain an appropriate collective Council/interim administration. Do not let the existing1971.12.2 character expiry create a federal presidency or end the treaty. Respect individual ruler succession; do not freeze a named ruler or blindly cycle the native leader pool.
